intent: Complete the architecture-stabilization pass by removing researcher-layer false negatives caused by standards that are stricter than their owning truth semantics require. Preserve no-lookahead, Evidence truthfulness, claim-scoped authority, source-independence, temporal precision, sealed-memory provenance and explicit Reality/Judgment/Outcome separation. Treat absent optional researcher enrichment as unsupported rather than defective, retain fail-closed behavior when a capability is explicitly declared but violates its contract, audit partial-period correction and industry-discovery propagation against existing semantic owners, and freeze generic architecture expansion unless this audit demonstrates a concrete unmet requirement.
rationale_summary: The final pre-freeze pass should widen discovery and optional researcher enrichment without weakening truth promotion. Existing CAP-0005 owns researcher orientation/replay, CAP-0007 owns fail-closed orchestration, and CAP-0010 owns architecture governance; RI-0006 requires reuse rather than a new semantic owner.
